senses.gloss: (a disguise of אלהים for the purpose of avoiding the utterance of the divine name, cmp. אֱלוֹהַּ) by God! forsooth (ironically). Pesik. Baḥod. p. 104ᵃ אלי׳ אני תובע בה Ar. (ed. אל אהא, Ms. Oxf. אליקי איני) forsooth, I shall propose to her, i.e. do you believe I shall &c.? Cant. R. to I, 4 אלעי׳ אני נותן וכ׳ forsooth (do you believe) I shall give &c. [V. Pesik. l. c. note 81.]
